title: Create a room
body: One person opens a room and invites friends with a link or a 4-digit code.

title: Write & fold
body: You see only the start of a sentence. Finish it, tap “fold the page”, then write the start of the next one.

title: Pass it on
body: Everyone sees whose turn it is. You get 3 minutes to finish the sentence and 2 to start the next, with a last call in the final 30 seconds.

title: Read the signed story
body: After the last line, everyone gets the same story on one sheet, signed by all who wrote it. Read it out loud.
